source_text: וַ/אֲנִי֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֔ת לְ/דָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַ/מָּדִ֑י עָמְדִ֛/י לְ/מַחֲזִ֥יק וּ/לְ/מָע֖וֹז לֽ/וֹ׃
english_snapshot: And as for me[a], in the first year of Darius the Mede[b], I stood up to strengthen and be a fortress to him.

signals.text: In the Hebrew tradition this is Daniel 11:1; in some English versifications it is counted as Daniel 10:21b–11:1 or Daniel 11:1 with slightly different chapter division.
